players.product: PCBs for DDR5 server memory modules (R-DIMM / U-DIMM / SO-DIMM), SSDs and back-end test equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results and mix (IR deck, Q1 2026 results presentation, KRW hundred million): revenue 758 (+4.5% QoQ, +43% YoY; third straight record quarter) and operating profit 107 (+25% QoQ, +473% YoY), OPM 14.1% (GPM 18.7%, EBITDA margin 17.1%); quarterly revenue 530 / 641 / 689 / 726 / 758 from Q1 2025 to Q1 2026. Q1 2026 revenue mix: DDR5 59%, SSD 34%, other incl. new products 7%; DDR5 6400/7200 MT/s modules were 83% of DDR5; high-value products exceeded 60% of revenue for a second straight quarter (27%, 32%, 51%, 62%, 61% from Q1 2025). The deck attributes the result partly to a higher exchange rate and a continuously rising blended ASP, and states that next-generation SOCAMM and LPCAMM modules are in mass production (since 01-2026). FY2025 revenue 2,585 and operating profit 260 vs 1,800 and 34 in 2024. Total borrowings 765 at Q1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue KRW 758 hundred million (+43% YoY), OP 107 (OPM 14.1%); DDR5 59% / SSD 34%; high-value products 61% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (IR deck, Q1 2026 results presentation): the company expects record-high revenue in 2026 as AI-server demand lifts demand for high-performance memory and storage PCBs. Q2 2026 outlook: Ansan plant 2 and the Masslam line at TLB VINA start operating and next-generation product mass production expands; in DDR5, rising demand for high-value memory modules and new development wins; in SSD, higher production on strong demand and a continued rise in eSSD share.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 revenue guided to a record high; no specific figure

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity plan (IR deck, Q1 2026 results presentation): growth-oriented production capex - Ansan plant 2 (bought 11-2025) starts operating in Q2 2026, the Masslam equipment invested in TLB VINA (09-2025) starts in Q2 2026, and a second Vietnam plant (TLB VINA plant 2) is scheduled to start operating in Q4 2027 as the overseas production base.
quarterly_data.figure: Ansan plant 2 and VINA Masslam line in Q2 2026; VINA plant 2 in Q4 2027
